cases.query: What are the main risks identified in the project?

context_chunks.text: Risk 1: Ollama model size exceeds available RAM on 16GB machines (Impact: High, Likelihood: Medium). Risk 2: PostgreSQL full-text search latency degrades above 1M documents (Impact: Medium, Likelihood: Low). Concern raised: test flakiness in CI due to shared database state. Not yet in risk register.

cases.query: How does the authentication system work end to end?

context_chunks.text: Authentication flow: 1) User submits credentials to POST /auth/login. 2) Server validates against bcrypt hash. 3) Issues JWT access token (15min TTL) + refresh token (httpOnly cookie, 7d TTL). 4) CSRF token returned in response body.
AuthMiddleware extracts JWT from Authorization header, validates signature and expiry. RefreshMiddleware handles token rotation on 401 responses.

cases.query: What is the full data ingestion pipeline?

context_chunks.text: Pipeline stages: 1) File watcher detects new/modified files. 2) MIME detection and metadata extraction. 3) Text extraction (PDF: pdfplumber, DOCX: python-docx, images: OCR). 4) Chunking (512 tokens, 50 token overlap). 5) Embedding via nomic-embed-text. 6) Storage: chunks in PostgreSQL, vectors in Qdrant.
Ingestion workers: 2 concurrent, P2_BACKGROUND priority. Batch size: 20 chunks per embedding call. Checkpoint after each file.

cases.query: What are the differences between the small and large LLM configurations?

context_chunks.text: Small model: phi3:mini (3.8B params), 5s timeout, temperature 0.0, used for classification and simple QA. Large model: llama3.1:8b, 15s timeout, temperature 0.1, used for complex synthesis and recap summaries. Both use Ollama /api/chat endpoint.

cases.query: Explain the search ranking algorithm.

context_chunks.text: Hybrid search: 1) Full-text search via PostgreSQL ts_rank_cd (weight 0.4). 2) Semantic search via Qdrant cosine similarity (weight 0.6). Results merged by reciprocal rank fusion. Top 10 results returned. Tie-breaking by recency.
Boosting rules: exact phrase match +0.2, title match +0.15, recent files (<7 days) +0.1. Penalty: low-quality OCR text -0.1.

cases.query: What cost optimizations have been implemented?

context_chunks.text: Optimizations: 1) Prompt caching reduces redundant Ollama calls by 40%. 2) Embedding batching (20 chunks) reduces overhead. 3) Connection pooling for PostgreSQL (min 5, max 20). 4) Redis caching for deterministic query results (TTL: 300s).
Resource controller ensures at most 1 concurrent LLM call (P1) and 2 concurrent embedding calls (P2). Prevents OOM on 16GB machines.
